title: Mandate reader on labelled instructions
about: Thirty plain-language instructions with the mandate a careful reader should extract. The expected values were written by the builder (an AI assistant), and no one else has reviewed them yet. They are judgement calls in places, and each is marked with a tag. A case passes only if all eight fields match exactly after coerceParsed; field-level accuracy is also reported. Fields not listed in `expect` must be empty: merchants, categories, perOrderCap, periodCap, askAbove and durationDays null, blockedWeekdays an empty list, autoApproveIrreversible false. Conventions given to the reader: amounts in rupees, '2k' is 2000, a week is 7 days, a month 30 days, only what the text states. `expectNotes` means the reader should flag a contradiction in `notes`; `expectUnresolved` lists shop names that must be reported as unresolved rather than mapped or dropped silently. Case G15 is a judgement call: instructions aimed at the reader are treated as text to ignore, not as mandate terms.
